details: @reaxuse/shared@0.0.1 is a React utility library published under a name resembling the legitimate @vueuse/shared package. This first version ships a set of React composables (createEventHook, createGlobalState, useDebounceFn, useThrottleFn, etc.) with no install-time lifecycle hooks and no network behaviour. The package name is a variant of the well-known @vueuse/shared package, and this appears to be a trust-establishing first release from a publisher whose prior packages have been confirmed malicious; treat the package and any subsequent versions as untrusted.
